critical_code_review_comments: PlayerRegistrations.jsx line 623 — the new 'Send back to Division' button reuses the /return-to-player endpoint. The button label + prompt talk about 'Division', but under the hood the endpoint is the same one used by the existing 'Return to Player' flow. Consider adding a distinguishing `return_type` field on the payload so future audit-trail entries can differentiate Division-bounce vs Player-bounce.

SquadDetail.jsx — the age-filter helpers `_seasonAgeCutoff`/`_ageOnDate` filter the player pool client-side only. If MPCA overrides via URL/DevTools they could pick over-age players. Consider a server-side guard on POST /tournaments/{tid}/selection that rejects members exceeding age_cap_years.

TournamentBasicsPanel.jsx AGE_GROUP_TO_CAP is a local const inside the component — it would be better exported from a shared constants module so the same mapping applies to any age filter/label derived elsewhere (e.g., PlayerRegistrations, PlayerRegister).
